incident.title: High 5xx error rate on demo-api

note.author: playbook
note.summary: A 1.8-minute burst of errors on demo-api that is clearing up by itself.

evidence.claim: 5xx error rate peaked at 22.8%, was elevated for 1.8 min and is already falling (now 6.7%).
The errors were "upstream connection reset" (×152).

note.nextStep: No action needed now. If this recurs several times a day, investigate connection handling and tune the alert's duration.
ruledOut: No deploy of demo-api in the 5 minutes before the signal rose.
note.likelyCause: Transient "upstream connection reset" errors; no dependency is failing and nothing changed.

incident.title: High P99 latency on demo-api

note.author: playbook
note.summary: demo-api slowed down right after release 1.4.1.

evidence.claim: p99 latency went from 92 ms to 1.44 s, leaving baseline at 10:51:00 UTC.
Release 1.4.1 "Search bookings by notes (#482)" shipped 1 min before onset.
evidence.query: SELECT version, commit, description, at FROM deploys WHERE service = 'demo-api' AND at >= '2026-11-13T09:51:30.000Z'

evidence.claim: In the slowest request, 100% of the time is spent in "SELECT bookings.search".
Worst route: /bookings at 1.44 s (was 91 ms).

note.nextStep: Roll back demo-api to the previous version. Then look at the query plan for "SELECT bookings.search".
note.likelyCause: Release 1.4.1 ("Search bookings by notes (#482)") made "SELECT bookings.search" slow.

incident.title: Memory near limit on demo-api

note.author: playbook
note.summary: demo-api memory is climbing steadily since release 1.4.2; it will hit its limit and restart.

evidence.claim: Process memory rose from 99 MB to 230 MB, rising at about 51 MB/min.
Release 1.4.2 "Cache worker profiles in memory (#490)" shipped 1 min before onset.
evidence.query: SELECT version, commit, description, at FROM deploys WHERE service = 'demo-api' AND at >= '2026-11-13T09:57:20.000Z'

note.nextStep: Roll back demo-api from 1.4.2 before the process is OOM-killed, then take a heap snapshot of the new code path.
note.likelyCause: A memory leak introduced in 1.4.2 ("Cache worker profiles in memory (#490)").

incident.title: High P99 latency on demo-api

note.author: playbook
note.summary: demo-api is slow because payments-stub is failing.

evidence.claim: demo-api p99 latency went from 92 ms to a peak of 2.49 s.
Calls to payments-stub are failing: errors 0.0% → 90.8%.
evidence.query:
(sum by (server_address) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="demo-api",http_response_status_code=~"5..|0"}[1m])) or 0 * sum by (server_address) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="demo-api"}[1m]))) / sum by (server_address) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="demo-api"}[1m]))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, server_address) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="demo-api"}[1m])))

evidence.claim: Calls to payments-stub slowed down: p99 98 ms → 4.21 s.
evidence.query:
(sum by (server_address) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="demo-api",http_response_status_code=~"5..|0"}[1m])) or 0 * sum by (server_address) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="demo-api"}[1m]))) / sum by (server_address) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="demo-api"}[1m]))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, server_address) (rate(http_client_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="demo-api"}[1m])))

evidence.claim: In the slowest request, 100% of the time is spent in "POST payments-stub".

note.nextStep: Check payments-stub's status page or owners. Consider failing fast or queueing bookings until it recovers.
ruledOut: Release 1.4.0 "Rollback to 1.4.0": the slowdown follows payments-stub, not the release.
note.likelyCause: payments-stub is down or degraded; demo-api passes its failures on to callers.
